reading: Amidst escalating heatwaves across Europe, extensive wildfires have necessitated the urgent evacuation of tens of thousands from a prominent French tourist destination.
The inferno, which has raged unabated for several days, continues to pose a significant threat to communities within the Gironde region.
Authorities have consequently issued a mandatory evacuation order encompassing the entirety of the picturesque Cap Ferret peninsula.
This popular coastal area, renowned for its oyster farming and pristine beaches, typically serves as a summer haven for both domestic and international visitors.
The decision to completely clear the peninsula underscores the dire nature of the ongoing environmental crisis.
Firefighting crews, supported by aerial water bombers, are strenuously engaged in efforts to contain the rapidly advancing flames.
However, persistent strong winds and exceptionally dry conditions are exacerbating the challenge, making containment particularly arduous for emergency services.
Residents and holidaymakers were instructed to depart immediately, carrying minimal belongings, as the conflagration drew perilously close to populated zones.
Local prefectural officials emphasised that public safety remains the paramount concern in these unprecedented circumstances.
The widespread destruction caused by these blazes highlights the increasing vulnerability of natural landscapes to climate-induced extreme weather events.

vocabulary.definition: In the middle of or surrounded by; in the atmosphere or a state of.
An extremely serious, urgent, or terrible quality or character of a situation.
Involved in an activity with great effort, energy, or determination.
Emphasizes, highlights, or draws particular attention to a fact, idea, or situation.
Making a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse or more severe.
not known to have happened before
to an unusual or very high degree
as a result of what happened before
covering a large area or involving many parts

entries.ja: 〜の真ん中で、〜に囲まれて。ある状況や雰囲気の中で。
entries.ko: ~의 한가운데에 있거나 ~에 둘러싸여 있는. 어떤 분위기나 상태에 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 在…中间或被…围绕；在某种氛围或状态中。
entries.es: En medio de o rodeado por; en la atmósfera o un estado de.
entries.pt-BR: No meio ou cercado por; em uma atmosfera ou estado de.

entries.ja: 状況が極めて深刻で、緊急を要する、または恐ろしい性質や特徴であること。
entries.ko: 상황의 극도로 심각하거나 긴급하거나 끔찍한 성격이나 특성.
entries.zh-Hans: 指某种情况极其严重、紧急或可怕的性质或特征。
entries.es: Una cualidad o carácter de una situación extremadamente grave, urgente o terrible.
entries.pt-BR: A qualidade ou característica de uma situação ser extremamente séria, urgente ou terrível.

entries.ja: 大きな努力、エネルギー、または決意を持って活動に参加している状態。
entries.ko: 엄청난 노력, 에너지 또는 결단력을 가지고 활동에 참여하고 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 投入一项活动时付出巨大的努力、精力或决心。
entries.es: Involucrado en una actividad con gran esfuerzo, energía o determinación.
entries.pt-BR: Envolvido em uma atividade com grande esforço, energia ou determinação.

entries.ja: 事実、考え、状況などを強調し、注目させる。
entries.ko: 어떤 사실, 생각 또는 상황을 강조하거나 특별히 주목하게 만든다.
entries.zh-Hans: 强调、突出或特别引起人们对某一事实、观点或情况的注意。
entries.es: Enfatiza, resalta o llama una atención particular a un hecho, idea o situación.
entries.pt-BR: Enfatiza, destaca ou chama uma atenção particular para um fato, ideia ou situação.

entries.ja: 問題、悪い状況、または否定的な感情をより悪化させる、またはより深刻にする。
entries.ko: 문제, 나쁜 상황 또는 부정적인 감정을 더 나쁘게 만들거나 더 심각하게 만드는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 使问题、不良情况或负面情绪变得更糟或更严重。
entries.es: Hacer que un problema, una mala situación o un sentimiento negativo empeore o se vuelva más grave.
entries.pt-BR: Tornar um problema, uma situação ruim ou um sentimento negativo pior ou mais grave.

entries.ja: これまでに起こったことがないと知られている。
entries.ko: 이전에 일어난 적이 없는 것으로 알려진.
entries.es: Que no se tiene conocimiento de que haya ocurrido antes.
entries.pt-BR: Que não se tem conhecimento de ter acontecido antes.

entries.ja: 異例の、または非常に高い程度に。
entries.zh-Hans: 异乎寻常地或达到非常高的程度。
entries.es: En un grado inusual o muy alto.
entries.pt-BR: Em um grau incomum ou muito alto.

entries.ja: 以前に起こったことの結果として。
entries.zh-Hans: 作为之前发生事情的结果。
entries.es: Como resultado de lo que sucedió antes.
entries.pt-BR: Como resultado do que aconteceu antes.

entries.ja: 広い範囲をカバーしている、または多くの部分を含んでいる。
entries.ko: 넓은 영역을 덮거나 여러 부분을 포함하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 覆盖大面积或涉及许多部分。
entries.es: Que cubre un área grande o que involucra muchas partes.
entries.pt-BR: Que abrange uma grande área ou envolve muitas partes.

entries.ja: 他の考慮事項よりも重要である。
